title: P2: UIAI_OPERATOR_BROWSER_DESKTOP_SPEC Phase A depends on Spec 104 scope-keyed session broker (child of uiai-engine-h6s)
notes:
Child of uiai-engine-h6s (P1 Spec 104 adoption).

The desktop operator browser spec at docs/UIAI_OPERATOR_BROWSER_DESKTOP_SPEC_2026-06-19.md Phase A requires:

- Tauri desktop shell
- connect to UIAI Engine
- show FPV/mirror/screenshot/diagnostics
- expose bounded action controls
- add health/capacity visibility

\u00a78.2 also calls for \u0022explicit session ownership/lock endpoint\u0022 and \u0022operator audit trail endpoint\u0022.

These both depend on the engine having:

1. A scope-keyed SessionManager (the broker, also uiai-engine-677 P2 open) so the desktop shell can show which agent/project owns which session.
2. A scope-keyed observability.ErrorStore (see sibling P2 bead) so the operator audit trail is per-scope, not a process-global mix.

Until uiai-engine-h6s and its children land, Phase A cannot honestly claim \u0022operator audit trail\u0022 because the audit trail itself has no scope awareness.

Acceptance:
- docs/UIAI_OPERATOR_BROWSER_DESKTOP_SPEC_2026-06-19.md \u00a78.2 references uiai-engine-h6s and the broker bead as Phase A prerequisites.
- Phase A acceptance criteria include \u0022audit trail is per-scope\u0022 and \u0022session ownership is per-scope\u0022 (not process-global).

Evidence citations required on close: doc diff + spec 104 PR hash.

Dependency: uiai-engine-h6s.

title: P2: scope-key observability.ErrorStore or classify as runtime-infra exception (child of uiai-engine-h6s)
P2: scope-key the SessionManager broker (child of uiai-engine-h6s)
notes:
Child of uiai-engine-h6s (P1 Spec 104 adoption in UIAI Engine).

Current state (internal/vision/session.go:67):

  type SessionManager struct {
      mu       sync.RWMutex
      sessions map[string]*Session
      pool     *Pool
  }

  const MaxSessions = 4

The map is keyed only by session ID; MaxSessions is a single process-global cap. Spec 104 \u00a77.2 (API routes) requires canonical-capable routes to be scope-keyed and blocked envelope on missing/ambiguous scope. Spec 104 \u00a73.1.A would flag this as authority-bearing singleton evidence.

What\u0027s needed:

1. Index sessions by (scope, sessionID) instead of just sessionID. Scope can be ScopeKind=Project (resolved via focusa_scope.project_root or workstream) or ScopeKind=Host (loopback agent suite).
2. MaxSessions should be per-scope (or globally guarded with a per-scope minimum allocation) so one project\u0027s parked sessions cannot starve another project\u0027s active ones.
3. /api/sessions list endpoint must include scope in each entry; pool-full errors must surface the caller\u0027s scope and the current scope\u0027s slot utilization, not the global count.
4. Safe parking: when scope transitions to host or is missing, parked sessions must be evicted or surfaced for explicit operator action; not silently held.
5. This work overlaps with the existing uiai-engine-677 (P2 open \u0022Track GitHub #1 browser session broker\u0022) but adds the typed-scope dimension.

Acceptance:
- (scope, sessionID) indexing proven by unit test.
- /api/sessions includes scope_kind + scope_id in response.
- MaxSessions is per-scope with documented minimum allocation.
- Pool-full error envelope includes caller scope + their scope\u0027s current count + global count.

Evidence citations required on close: spec 104 PR hash + test artifact path.

Dependency: uiai-engine-h6s must land first (typed-scope contract reference).
